newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Avonmore issues $100 mln of preferred securities.
newsitem.headline: Avonmore issues $100 mln of preferred securities.

text.p: Irish-based food group Avonmore said on Friday it had issued $100 million 7.99 percent cumulative preferred securities, redeemable in November 2006.
"Avonmore intends to use the proceeds in the short-term to pay down outstanding debt, and in the medium-to-longer term to expand its operations," it said in a statement.
Avonmore Foods Plc said the preferred securities were investment grade, and rated baa3 by Moody's Investors Service and BBB- by Standard and Poor's.
The preferred securities are guaranteed by Avonmore, and renewable for further 10-year periods after 2006 by mutual consent, it said.
They were sold on a private placement basis to institutional investors, and Merrill Lynch acted as sole manager for the offering, Avonmore said.
"The preferred securities represent an important element in the overall financing of Avonmore and widens our investor base," Avonmore group managing director Pat O'Neill said in a statement.
"This new subordinated capital adds further significant capacity to the group's balance sheet and strongly positions us to avail of strategic opportunities over the coming years," he said.
